symptom: During bake stage observed CD drift and profile map deviation; alarm E-4201 was logged repeatedly.
action_log:
1) Initial inspection: chamber visual check completed.
2) Confirmed valve operation 정상, pump 상태 OK.
3) Measured CD on affected lot: 210 nm (out of expected range).
4) Recorded hotplate profile: zone 편차 4℃ 이상 확인.
5) Notified 고객팀 및 승인 후 정밀 점검 실시.
resolution_note: Replaced hotplate heater and serviced adjacent valve and chamber seating. Performed profile re-calibration and verified track 온습도(℃) stability. Post-repair verification showed CD within control; equipment returned to service after 고객 승인.
